theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds Need Big Money To Start
body: Myth: You need lakhs to invest. Reality: Start with small amounts through systematic approaches and grow gradually.
caption: Many believe mutual fund investing requires significant upfront capital. In reality, structured investing plans allow you to begin with modest amounts and build wealth over time through consistency. #MutualFundMyths #InvestingBasics #WealthBuilding #DebunkingMyths #SmartInvesting
